review_kind: single independent full-context source/pixel figure review

source_fidelity.method: Original PNG opened separately at original resolution before reading the figure spec/inventory. Outward arrows counted visually; read-only thresholded connected-component boxes corroborate those individually visible arrows, excluding apparatus, gas dots and the transfer label.
independent_inventory: One cylinder with two side walls and closed bottom, one fixed hatched piston spanning the chamber and one upward central rod; no alternate piston position or motion arrow.
A gas-dot cloud below the piston, not a numerical particle-count or density dataset.
Twenty-five distinct outward heat-transfer arrows around the sides and bottom.
One source transfer label, faithfully localized as Heat transfer.
source_fidelity.box_limits: Boxes locate original arrow ink for this inventory only; they are not measured thermodynamic data or proposed exact modern drawing coordinates.

deterministic_validator.scope_limit: Executable geometry and the author render passing do not certify completeness of the author's source inventory.

visual_semantics.assessment: At every inspected width, the piston closes the gas chamber, outward arrowheads remain visible, and Heat transfer is readable without overlap. The frozen n25 context explicitly fixes the piston and contrasts heat loss with adiabatic expansion; the figure adds no motion arrow, work value, temperature value, formula or answer. Regularized dimensions, hatching, angular spacing and 63 gas markers are illustration choices, not measurements. No non-English visible label or source-culture leakage.

findings.finding: The original contains 25 individually identifiable outward arrows. The inventory incorrectly claims 24 and the current spec/render contains only heat-arrow-1 through heat-arrow-24. This is a source-object omission even though qualitative heat flow and the deterministic renderer pass.
findings.targeted_repair: Correct the source inventory to 25 and preserve 25 visible outward arrows with mapped endpoint/connectivity assertions. Qualitative angular regularization may remain explicitly a modern drawing choice. Retain the unchanged fixed apparatus, gas-cloud declaration, full prose/context and readable label; rerender only the affected figure and bind its new outputs for changed-only checking.

reviewer_edits: Only this scratch report; no figure, spec, author template, source or previous evidence changed.
limits: No prose-science repeat, answer access, browser, network/model calls, dependency/app/DB operations, promotion, finalize or commit. This report preserves the evaluated failing bytes, not approval of later repairs.
